title: 第1章  重生
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
刑罚堂大殿里面。
“你这个孽障，还不给我跪下！”
白衣胜雪，丰神俊秀，清雅绝尘的玉阳仙尊坐在高处，一双蓝色的眼瞳压抑着怒意，看着站在大殿中央的少女。
大殿四周站了不少的人，这些人露出或是愤怒、或是嫉恨、或是看好戏、或是平静的样子看着大殿中央的少女。
少女瞧着十四岁左右的样子，乌黑的长发垂腰，肌肤如雪白皙，五官精致绝伦，虽然还年幼，但已经足以称之为绝色了。
少女有着一双紫罗兰色的眼睛，忽地她全身一颤，那双美丽的眼眸望着四周露出了震惊之色。
谢莲心震惊无比，怎么回事？
她不是应该死了吗？
她应该跟黑天帝同归于尽了才对，为什么会在这里？周围那一张张熟悉又陌生的脸，这些家伙应该全部都死了的，已经死了不知道多少年的家伙，一个个站在她身边，而且这场景……
她回到过去了吗？
还是中了幻术？
高处，玉阳仙尊谢逸见谢莲心居然还走神了，怒气又加倍了。
“谢莲心！”
高处传来的清冷声音带着愠怒，谢莲心抬起头，看着高处坐着的男人，瞳孔骤然收缩。
她没想到还能再看到活生生的他。
谢逸名义上是她师尊，实际上是她的亲生父亲。因为她的母亲是魔尊独孤玄夜（独孤静），所以他不承认她的身份，只跟人说她是他收养的孤女。
谢莲心一开始不知道自己的身份，她就是不懂为什么师尊收养了她，却总是对她那么的冷漠，动不动就责罚她。可是他对小师妹柳如烟，却又是关怀备至。
后面知道自己身份之后，她无法接受，离开了玄天宗，在诸天万界流浪，然后被她的母亲独孤玄夜捡了回去，成了二代魔尊。
她一直觉得谢逸和独孤玄夜都不爱她，一个甚是不愿意承认她是他女儿，一个出生就把她扔了，他们怎么会爱她呢？
直到黑天帝灭世，他们为了她而死，她才明白他们确实爱着她，只是那爱藏得太深了，她才看不懂。

谢莲心望着高处的父亲，想起他为自己挡下了黑天帝的剑，他的血飞溅到自己脸上，他将自己全部的力量打入她的身体里，他说：“活下去！”
他在她面前魂飞魄散，直到最后她也没能喊他一声“爹”。
她应该死了的，她无法接受父母都为自己而死，拉着黑天帝同归于尽了。
你要灭世是吧，那你也不要活了，大家一起毁灭吧。
现在到底是个什么情况，她重生了吗？
一切开始重新开始了吗？
晶莹的眼泪从谢莲心的眼眶涌出，高处的谢逸看着红了眼眶的少女，见她泪眼盈盈的样子，呆愣住了。
不仅仅是谢逸，大殿里面其他人全部都愣住了。
谢莲心她、她哭了，她竟然哭了？
谁都知道谢莲心的脾气多硬，她居然会哭？
“谢莲心，你别以为你哭几声，你重伤小师妹的事情就一笔勾销了。”一个声音突兀地响起，说话的是个浓眉大眼的青年。
谢莲心泪眼朦胧地瞥了旁边一眼，就看到了旁边站着的宋璇和柳如烟。
柳如烟，黑天帝的走狗。但现在的她，还只是一个普通的修士。
前世这女人没少挑拨他们父女的关系，也没少挑拨她父母的关系，她全家沦落到那副凄惨下场，这女人算是功不可没。
脸上不显，谢莲心内心已经迅速调整了心态，她记起了现在的状况：昨天柳如烟不小心砸了她的灵兽蛋，她很生气，而所有人都站在柳如烟这边，让她原谅柳如烟。她气不过，今日跟柳如烟切磋的时候，下手重了。
本来只想要给自己出口恶气的，柳如烟这家伙竟然顺势自己重伤了自己，然后全部推到她身上。
柳如烟在玄天宗就像是个宝贝，人人喜欢，她被重伤，各峰的师兄师姐们可心疼坏了。
众人义愤填膺。
他们怕她的处罚太轻了，故意将事情闹大了，所以有了众人一起在这刑罚堂大殿中审判她的事情。
柳如烟依旧是谢莲心记忆中的模样，梳着松松的发髻，俏丽的小脸略显苍白，看着柔弱无比，那身姿更是如同风中弱柳，看她一眼就会激起众人无限的保护欲。

柳如烟虽然之前被重伤但是服下了各种灵丹妙药，伤势早已经恢复得差不多了。但她一触及谢莲心的视线，面容就白了，好像随时能晕死过去一样，那怯怯弱弱害怕的样子，看得众人更心疼了。
谢莲心这家伙，平日到底怎么欺负烟儿师妹了，只是一个眼神，就能吓到烟儿师妹，这家伙的罪行怕是罄竹难书。
谢莲心恨不得现在弄死她，但是还不行。她收回视线，看向了高处的父亲，扑通一声跪下了。她的眼泪如同断了线的珠子，啪嗒啪嗒地往下掉：“我错了，师尊，我错了，我不是故意的，我不是故意的……”
“我不知道师妹这么弱，我都说了我不会指点人，她非要跟我切磋，我不是有意的，我明明收了力的，师尊，我不是故意的……我不是故意的，呜呜……”
谢莲心哭得稀里哗啦的，谢逸震惊不已，他已经不记得上次她哭是什么时候的事情了？
她是从不轻易掉眼泪的，哪怕再痛也不会哭，每一次他训练她，无论伤多重，流多少的血，她都没哭过。
她太坚强了，坚强到他都忘记了她只是个十四岁的小女孩。
他总是觉得自己下手重，好过日后遇上敌人死在敌人手里，却忘记了她也会痛，忘记了她的感受。她是不是以为自己是故意下重手？
谢逸忽然觉得愧疚，瞥了眼柳如烟，觉得柳如烟小题大做了。
明明比莲心大四岁，动不动就哭，不过是随便受点伤，就这么兴师动众的，要是人人都如此，这玄天宗的弟子都成什么样了？
“别哭了，起来吧。”谢逸看着谢莲心，语气不自觉地温和了。
柳如烟立即感到的不妙。
“切磋受伤在所难免，谁切磋不受伤的。这点小事情，还要劳师动众的，我玄天宗弟子怎么除魔卫道？”谢逸目光冷冷地扫视众人，所有人触及他的目光都不由自主地颤了颤。
柳如烟当即白了脸色。
她特难堪，师尊这番话，简直就是当众打她的脸。
师尊，师尊怎么可以这样呢？
————
境界划分：炼气、筑基、结丹（金丹）、元婴、化神、炼虚、合体、大乘、渡劫、成仙。
content_en:
Inside the main hall of the Penal Hall.
"You evil deed, why don't you kneel down to me!"
The Yuyang Immortal Lord, who is dressed in white and is as handsome as the snow, is elegant and elegant, is sitting high up, with a pair of blue eyes suppressing his anger, looking at the girl standing in the center of the hall.
There were many people standing around the hall. These people looked at the girl in the center of the hall with expressions of anger, jealousy, watching a show, or calmness.
The girl looked about fourteen years old, with long black hair hanging down her waist, skin as white as snow, and exquisite facial features. Although she was still young, she was already beautiful enough to be called stunning.
The girl had a pair of violet eyes. Suddenly her whole body trembled, and her beautiful eyes looked around with a look of shock.
Xie Lianxin was extremely shocked. What happened?
Shouldn't she be dead?
She should have died together with Emperor Heitian. Why is she here? There were familiar and unfamiliar faces around her. All of these guys should be dead. Guys who had been dead for who knows how many years were standing next to her one by one. And this scene...
Has she gone back in time?
Or was he under an illusion?
High above, Yuyang Immortal Lord Xie Yi saw that Xie Lianxin was still distracted, and his anger doubled.
"Thank you Lianxin!"
The cold voice coming from above was sullen. Xie Lianxin raised her head and looked at the man sitting above, her pupils suddenly contracted.
She didn't expect to see him alive again.
Xie Yi is nominally her master, but actually her biological father. Because her mother is the Demon Lord Dugu Xuanye (Dugu Jing), he does not recognize her identity and only tells others that she is an orphan girl he adopted.
Xie Lianxin didn't know her identity at first. She just didn't understand why the master adopted her but was always so indifferent to her and punished her at every turn. But he cared deeply about his junior sister Liu Ruyan.
After learning her identity later, she couldn't accept it and left the Xuantian Sect, wandering around the world. Then she was picked up by her mother, Dugu Xuanye, and became the second-generation Demon Lord.
She always felt that neither Xie Yi nor Dugu Xuanye loved her. One was unwilling to admit that she was his daughter and abandoned her as soon as she was born. How could they love her?
It wasn't until Emperor Black Heaven destroyed the world and they died for her that she realized that they did love her, but that love was hidden too deep for her to understand.
Xie Lianxin looked at her father high up, remembering that he blocked Emperor Black Heaven's sword for her, and his blood splashed on her face. He poured all his strength into her body, and he said: "Live!"
He was so stunned in front of her that she couldn't call him "Dad" until the end.
She should be dead. She couldn't accept that her parents died for her, so she dragged Emperor Heitian to die together.
If you want to destroy the world, then you don’t want to live anymore. Let’s destroy it together.
What is the situation now? Is she reborn?
Is everything starting to start again?
Crystal tears welled up from Xie Lianxin's eyes. Xie Yi from above looked at the girl with red eyes and was stunned when he saw her eyes full of tears.
Not only Xie Yi, but everyone else in the hall was stunned.
Thank you Lianxin for her, she cried, she actually cried?
Everyone knows how hard-tempered Xie Lianxin is, but she actually cries?
"Xie Lianxin, don't think that if you cry a few times, the serious injury to your junior sister will be wiped out." A voice suddenly sounded, and the speaker was a young man with thick eyebrows and big eyes.
Xie Lianxin glanced to the side with tearful eyes, and saw Song Xuan and Liu Ruyan standing next to them.
Liu Ruyan, the lackey of Emperor Black Heaven. But now she is just an ordinary monk.
In the previous life, this woman had often provoked the relationship between their father and daughter, as well as the relationship between her parents. This woman was indispensable for the miserable fate that her whole family had fallen into.
Without showing it on her face, Xie Lianxin quickly adjusted her mentality. She remembered the current situation.: Yesterday Liu Ruyan accidentally smashed her spirit beast egg. She was very angry, but everyone stood by Liu Ruyan and asked her to forgive Liu Ruyan. She was so angry that when she was sparring with Liu Ruyan today, she was very aggressive.
Originally just wanting to vent his anger, Liu Ruyan took advantage of the situation and seriously injured himself, and then pushed it all onto her.
Liu Ruyan is like a treasure in Xuantian Sect, everyone loves her, but she was seriously injured, and the senior brothers and sisters from all peaks feel very sad.
Everyone was filled with indignation.
They were afraid that her punishment would be too light and they would deliberately make the matter bigger, so they decided to try her together in the main hall of the punishment hall.
Liu Ruyan still looks like what Xie Lianxin remembers, with her hair in a loose bun, her pretty little face slightly pale, she looks extremely weak, and her figure is like a weak willow in the wind. One look at her will arouse everyone's infinite desire for protection.
Although Liu Ruyan was seriously injured before, he had taken various miraculous medicines and his injuries had almost recovered. But as soon as she touched Xie Lianxin's sight, her face turned pale, as if she could faint at any time. Her timid and frightened look made everyone feel even more distressed.
How on earth does Xie Lianxin bully Junior Sister Yan'er on weekdays? Just a look can scare Junior Sister Yan'er. This guy's crimes are probably too numerous to describe.
Xie Lianxin wanted to kill her now, but it wasn't possible yet. She withdrew her gaze, looked at her father above, and knelt down with a plop. Her tears were like broken beads, pattering down: "I was wrong, Master, I was wrong, I didn't mean it, I didn't mean it..."
"I didn't know Junior Sister was so weak. I told you that I don't know how to give advice. She insisted on sparring with me. I didn't mean to do it. I obviously withdrew my strength. Master, I didn't do it on purpose... I didn't do it on purpose, wuwu..."
Xie Lianxin cried so hard that Xie Yi was shocked. He couldn't remember the last time she cried?
She never shed tears easily, no matter how painful it was. Every time he trained her, no matter how serious the injury was or how much blood was shed, she never cried.
She was so strong, so strong that he forgot that she was just a fourteen-year-old girl.
He always felt that it would be better for him to strike hard than to die in the hands of an enemy in the future, but he forgot that she would also feel pain and how she felt. Did she think she was being harsh on purpose?
Xie Yi suddenly felt guilty and glanced at Liu Ruyan, feeling that Liu Ruyan was making a fuss.
He is obviously four years older than Lian Xin, but he cries at every turn. He is just injured casually, and he just mobilizes the army and mobilizes the crowd. If everyone is like this, what will happen to the disciples of Xuantian Sect?
"Stop crying, get up." Xie Yi looked at Xie Lianxin and his tone became gentle unconsciously.
Liu Ruyan immediately felt something bad.
"It is inevitable to get injured during sparring. No one will get hurt during sparring. Such a trivial matter requires a lot of effort. How can I, a disciple of the Xuantian Sect, eliminate demons and protect the Tao?" Xie Yi glanced at the crowd coldly, and everyone who touched his eyes trembled involuntarily.
Liu Ruyan immediately turned pale.
She was extremely embarrassed. Master's words were like a slap in the face in front of everyone.
Master, how could Master do this?
————
The realms are divided into: refining Qi, building foundation, forming elixir (golden elixir), Nascent Soul, transforming into gods, refining void, integrating body, Mahayana, overcoming tribulation, and becoming immortal.
